## Premise correction

Read at `origin/main` `65b49208`, 2026-10-28T15:48Z. Premises 1 and 2 hold. Premise 3 holds only in part, and several work-item sentences name doors the runtime does not deliver at base, so under Prime Directive #10 (the card's own Governing text) they change form; the target is unchanged:

1. `pnpm verify` does not exist (root `package.json` has no `verify` script). Name real scripts (`pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm docs:build`) or the docs page's own build.
2. The screenshot convention `assets/screenshots/<screen>/<locale>.png` + `meta.yaml` has no reader: `meta.yaml` 0 hits in `packages/ scripts/ apps/`; `os package publish` sends no screenshots (it reads `translations.screenshotCaptions`, `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts:600-613`, and `--icon-file`, `:392`). The handbook states that screenshots are not carried by publish at base; the acceptance line "a listing with icon, screenshots and two locales" reads "icon and two locales".
3. HotCRM's `objectstack.manifest.json` (`353dace`) has no `translations` and no `preview`; it is the worked example only for the keys it carries.
4. The credential prompt is not delivered (#27237 in flight, #27238 blocked) and no "env-var path" for an installed app's credential is evidenced at base: describe only the README-prose convention and name #27237 / #27238.
5. Uninstall has no `os package uninstall`; it is `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` plus a restart (`publish-and-preview.mdx:208`). Enable / disable exists only as `PATCH /:id/enable|disable` on the runtime dispatcher (`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts:1596-1597`): name that surface or leave the step out.
6. "What happens to an app that falls behind" (leaving the catalog) has no source in this repository: leave it out. "What review examines" likewise: state only what the CLI prints and the listing statuses.
7. Field lists live in the auto-generated `content/docs/references/marketplace/*.mdx`: link them, do not restate them.
